comments.author: Young
comments.body: Me and my family rleluargy have UK cottage breaks that we book through the internet. We've always had a great time and have seen some lovely parts of the country. However, this summer we had a particularly bad experience with the cottage owner who accused us of all kinds of mischief which were blatant lies.My advice to fellow travellers is to scour the net for independant reviews of cottages/hotels before booking up. The opinions of others who have gone before are priceless.Gavin

comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
^Correction to the above post:

England Bandit Lv2 actually has Chain Swing R1 (B) tech, with no level requirements. And Strike Down is actually a R2 (R) tech. So I think the correct loadout is as follows:

AXE
England Bandit Lv2, Life Points (50)
-- Strike Down R2(R), (SP R3, Power 4, Bring down acquired)
-- Drop Down R1(Y), (No Requirements.... Axe Equipped)
-- Chain Swing R1 (B), (No Requirements.... Axe Equipped)
-- Trick Axe R1*(Y), (SP R3, Feint R4, (Drop Down acquired)
-- Big Drop Down R2(Y), (SP R8, Feint R8, (Drop Down acquired)
